title: State Bank of Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: State Bank of Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE IX OF 2001
STATE BANK OF
PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2001
ORDINANCE IX OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 20th February, 2001]
F.No.2(1)/2001-Pub., dated 20-2-2001.---The following by the
President is hereby published 'for' general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the State Bank of Pakistan
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: State Bank of Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Insertion of new section 8-A, Act XXXIII of 1956

ORDINANCE IX OF 2001
STATE BANK OF
PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2001
ORDINANCE IX OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 20th February, 2001]
F.No.2(1)/2001-Pub., dated 20-2-2001.---The following by the
President is hereby published 'for' general information:--
2. Insertion of new section
8A, Act XXXIII of 1956.---In the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956 (XXXIII
of 1956), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, after section 8, the
following new section shall be inserted, namely:--
"8A. Establishment
and maintenance of subsidiary or trust.---Notwithstanding anything to this
Act or in any other law for the time being in force, the Bank may establish and
maintain a subsidiary or a trust for the following purposes, namely:--
(a) for catering
to all training needs of the Bank employees, .financial sector and other
agencies, organizations or institutions pertaining to banking and finance
sector;
(b) for handling
the function of receipt, supply and exchange of Bank notes and coins which are
legal tender;
(c) for issue,
supply, sale and purchase of prize bonds holding draws thereof and other
National Savings Instruments; and
(d) generally
for carrying out any other business or discharging any functions incidental to,
or connected with, the affairs of the Bank.".

sections.shortTitle: State Bank of Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Substitution of section 49, Act XXXIII of 1956

ORDINANCE IX OF 2001
STATE BANK OF
PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2001
ORDINANCE IX OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 20th February, 2001]
F.No.2(1)/2001-Pub., dated 20-2-2001.---The following by the
President is hereby published 'for' general information:--
4. Substitution of section 49,
Act XXXIII of 1956.--In the said Act, for section 49 the following shall be
substituted, namely:--
"49. Exemption
from taxes.--Notwithstanding anything in the Wealth Tax Act, 1963 (XV of
1963), and Income Tax Ordinance, 1979 (XXXI of 1979), or any other law for the
time being in force relating to wealth tax, income-tax or super tax the Bank
and any subsidiary, or trust, established by it shall not be liable to pay
wealth tax, income-tax or super-tax on their income or wealth."
